name: Fish in a Bucket
summary: Jinar'Zillen of Shadowprey Village in Desolace likes to do as little as possible. Many shellfish traps sit below the village docks, and anyone who gathers the shellfish from them will be repaid with something worth having.

sections.title: Work Done by Someone Else
sections.body: Jinar'Zillen keeps many shellfish traps below the docks of Shadowprey Village, and would far rather someone else did the collecting. Anyone willing to take on that work is promised something they want in return: one fine Bloodbelly fish for every five shellfish brought in.

aliases: who gives fish in a bucket

Below the docks of Shadowprey Village.

faq.q: Why does Jinar'Zillen want someone else to gather the shellfish?
faq.answer: Jinar'Zillen enjoys doing as little as possible, so anyone who collects from the traps is promised something in return.

faq.q: What does Jinar'Zillen give in return for the shellfish?
faq.answer: One fine Bloodbelly fish for every five shellfish.
